theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoIntertwiner.braidTrace_eq_kz_of_intertwiner {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) (wi : ℂ) (β : IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.BraidGroupN m) :
IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.braidTrace (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ ⋯ w wi β = wi ^ (m + 1) * (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) ((SchurWeyl.JimboActionKernel.skeinCoxAEquiv (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m).symm ↑((IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.heckeRep (IwahoriHecke.TensorEmbed.coxA m) ⋯ ⋯) β))).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoIntertwiner.siteWeight_trace_kz_eq_jimbo_of_intertwiner {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m) :
(IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x).trace = (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoIntertwiner.weighted_trace_kz_eq_jimbo_of_intertwiner {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m) :
((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) => f (KohnoWeighted.cnt a)) * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x).trace = ((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) => f (KohnoWeighted.cnt a)) * (KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoIntertwiner.weighted_trace_eq_of_intertwiner {N : ℕ} (U : (Matrix (Fin N → Fin 2) (Fin N → Fin 2) ℂ)ˣ) (hU : KohnoWeighted.WP ↑U) {X Y : Matrix (Fin N → Fin 2) (Fin N → Fin 2) ℂ} (h : ↑U * X = Y * ↑U) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin N → Fin 2) => f (KohnoWeighted.cnt a)) * X).trace = ((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin N → Fin 2) => f (KohnoWeighted.cnt a)) * Y).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoIntertwiner.kz_jimbo_intertwiner {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) :
∃ (U : (Matrix (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) ℂ)ˣ), KohnoWeighted.WP ↑U ∧ ∀ (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m), ↑U * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x = (KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x * ↑U
